analysis: The residual MultVAE + SASRec ensemble achieved host-evaluated validation macro HR@10 of 0.6250: +0.0075 over the supplied 0.6175 ensemble and +0.0050 over the reported 0.6200 best. Category HR@10 was Movies_and_TV 0.6500, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.6900, Electronics 0.4500, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.7100. Electronics remains the weakest category. The result supports retaining the residual variant, although one run cannot establish why it improved. The trial consumed 944.64 allocated GPU-seconds; no test results were supplied.
code_summary: Added a parameter-free residual path to MultVAE: h = tanh(decoder_hidden(z)) + encoder_hidden. The 256-dimensional encoder representation is computed once and shared by posterior estimation and the residual path around the 64-dimensional latent bottleneck. Preserved the multinomial loss, KL annealing, optimizer, SASRec expert, and equal-weight rank fusion. Saved residual=True in checkpoints and reconstructed it in the exported predictor. Retained four-dataset routing, independent expert checkpoint selection, reload/export agreement checks, training seed 42, and SASREC_EPOCHS default 200.
